configuration.optimizer: exact rational coordinate pattern search; initial step1/2, halve after a nonimproving sweep
configuration.state_arithmetic: arbitrary precision integers and Fraction; projective exact normalization
configuration.shape_family: all four exact source cardinal polynomials on x_i=i/(2^n-1)
configuration.cayley_refinement: t_d times (-1)^bit((d+1) modulo n), ordered by qubit; noncommuting neighboring controls
configuration.source_baseline: source H/Ry/CZ structure; two Ry/CZ ring layers, rational Cayley gate parameters
configuration.diagnostics: Eigensolver, plotted decimals and QASM physical angles are numerical boundary outputs; optimizer comparisons stay rational.
